common: Use case: precise-object-edit. Original painted fantasy JRPG skill icon revision. Preserve round-1 painted brush shading, crisp bevels, top-left light, substantial dark contour, warm gold trim, exact class palette family and motif identity. Simplify fine filigree and tiny sparks into bolder masses; brighter solid motif separated from restrained darker glow. Readable at native 40px on navy #0b1730 under 61% black cooldown overlay. Centered opaque motif fills 75-80% of square, maximum extent about 198px in 256px export. Entire motif and all effects fit centered 224px-diameter safe circle. Genuine transparent background. One icon only. No text, letters, numbers, frames, border, UI, rarity colours, watermark, new scenery.

followup_edits.rouse: Change only the banner fabric to warm golden yellow, with dark royal blue insignia and blue edging; preserve pole and mint healing glow.
followup_edits.bolt: Steepen the same astral needle to 15 degrees from vertical, rising up/right, retaining white star head and violet threaded wake.
followup_edits.pierce: Make the same spear thrust a shallow 15-degree diagonal rising right from horizontal; retain teal ribbon and two pale energy slivers.
followup_edits.hinder: Pack thorn vine into a compact near round cluster with one vertical broadhead arrow passing through.
followup_edits.weakshot: Make bronze target ring large and near circular; shorten arrow shaft to remain inside its exterior extent.
followup_edits.quake: Pack cracked ground and upward stone burst into a compact dome with a broad base, centered hammer head and shortened handle.

packing.subvisible_alpha_cleanup: alpha < 4/255 set to zero before normalization and after resampling
packing.method: Uniform Lanczos resampling and minimum-enclosing-circle positioning; no nonuniform stretching, circular clipping or painted-over motifs.
